newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide denies bid rumours - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide denies bid rumours - newspaper.

text.p: Nationwide, Britain's largest building society, dismissed speculation that it might be the subject of a takeover bid and denied valuing itself at 7.0 billion pounds as part of a search for a trade buyer, the Financial Times reported.

The newspaper said that uncertainty over the society's future had been sparked by a campaign by five rebels to join the board and force it to convert to a bank follwing rivals Alliance & Leicester and the Halifax Plc's conversions.

"We have not had a bid, we have not considered a bid and we do not expect to receive one," the society was quoted as saying. "Even if a bid was put on the table, it is very unlikely that we would change our strategy."
The Nationwide on Wednesday said it remained committed to maintaining its mutual status despite the recent rash of building societes rushing to the stock market.
The society was not immediately available for comment.
